biography: Lucas Kohl, born in Curitiba, Brazil, is a racing driver known for his flashy style and unwavering determination. His journey began at a young age, fueled by the roaring engines of local karting events. A defining moment came at 16 when, despite a severely damaged kart, he pushed it across the finish line, earning him the nickname 'Garra' (Claw) for his tenacity. This raw display of will caught the eye of a local racing team owner, providing him with his first real opportunity. He spent several years honing his skills in various Brazilian racing series, showcasing glimpses of brilliance mixed with occasional over-aggression. His move to touring cars with MM AJR Honda Gen2 marked a turning point. While championships have eluded him, his undeniable speed and captivating presence make him a consistent threat and a fan favorite. Currently, he continues to strive for that elusive championship victory, splitting his time between simulator training and intense physical conditioning.
drivingStyle: Kohl's driving style is characterized by an aggressive, late-braking approach. He's known for his daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of grip and track boundaries. Tire management is an area he's actively working on, as his initial aggression can sometimes lead to late-race degradation. Under pressure, Kohl tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes resulting in errors, but also leading to some of his most spectacular performances. He thrives in chaotic races, using his instinct and car control to navigate through the field.
rivalries: Ricardo Vargas - A long-standing rivalry dating back to their karting days. Vargas is known for his calculated, methodical approach, a stark contrast to Kohl's impulsive style, creating frequent on-track clashes.

Isabela Monteiro - A fierce competitor who has consistently challenged Kohl's dominance on the track. Their battles are characterized by clean but intense racing, pushing each other to the absolute limit.
Kenji Tanaka - A Japanese driver who joined the touring car series. They have had several heated arguments post-race after Kohl was accused of dangerous blocking.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother, for every race.
Listens to a specific Brazilian samba song immediately before putting on his helmet.
Has a habit of tracing the outline of the track map with his finger while visualizing his first lap.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed; it's about heart. You have to want it more than anyone else, be willing to risk everything for that checkered flag."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Touring Car Grand Prix at Interlagos in 2020. He started from the back of the grid due to a mechanical failure in qualifying but fought his way through the field with a series of breathtaking overtakes, securing a memorable victory in front of his home crowd.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the 2021 championship decider. A momentary lapse in concentration led to a spin, handing the title to his rival, Ricardo Vargas. This event fueled a renewed focus on consistency and composure.
